name: Guard Berton
summary: Outside the Lakeshire Inn, Guard Berton presses for swift justice against Targorr the Dread. Redridge faces the Blackrock orc invasion, and Stormwind's delays have worn thin.

sections.title: A Guard Seeking Justice
sections.body:
Guard Berton keeps watch outside the Lakeshire Inn as the Blackrock orc invasion threatens Redridge Mountains. Targorr the Dread, an enemy captured for crimes against the kingdom, is locked deep in the Stormwind Stockade and sentenced to death. Yet Stormwind has postponed his execution indefinitely.

With Lakeshire bleeding, Berton will not let the brutal raider linger in a cell. He hires willing adventurers to bypass the delays and kill the orc.

faq.answer: Guard Berton is an Alliance guardsman posted outside the Lakeshire Inn in Redridge Mountains. He hires adventurers to carry out justice against an infamous orc prisoner.

faq.q: Why does Guard Berton want Targorr the Dread killed?
faq.answer: Stormwind has postponed Targorr the Dread's execution, though he was sentenced for crimes against the kingdom. With Redridge under siege, Berton arranges for Targorr to be killed inside the Stockade.

faq.q: Where is Targorr the Dread held?
faq.answer: Targorr the Dread is held in the Stockade, a high-security dungeon in Stormwind City's Canal district.

faq.q: Where can Guard Berton be found?
faq.answer: Guard Berton keeps watch just outside the Lakeshire Inn, overlooking Lakeshire's town center in Redridge.

angles.text: As an Alliance defender, you can understand why border towns grow frustrated when Stormwind's bureaucracy delays justice while they fight for survival.
